headline: Sales and operating profit edge higher
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 3.77T, up 11.2% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 241B, up 3.7% y/y, while net income fell 9.6% y/y to KRW 176.5B.
summary_long: Third-party coverage reports revenue above consensus and operating profit below it. Year-to-date operating profit is down about 24.6% from a year earlier. Net income of KRW 176.5B compares with KRW 195.2B a year ago. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and operating profit come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary results; net income is the Yahoo shard value (one source quotes a 10.1% decline).
